info.name: CRE Analytics
info.description:
Postman collection for CRE Analytics Firebase Functions API

## Setup

This collection uses variables to switch between local emulator and production environments.

### Local Emulator
Set these variables in the collection:
- `baseUrl`: `http://127.0.0.1:5001/demo-cre-analytics/southamerica-east1/api`
- `projectId`: (paste from backoffice)
- `projectKey`: (paste from backoffice)

### Production
Set these variables in the collection:
- `baseUrl`: `https://southamerica-east1-YOUR_PROJECT.cloudfunctions.net/api`
- `projectId`: (paste from backoffice)
- `projectKey`: (paste from backoffice)

### REST API Format
Standard REST endpoints with JSON bodies:
- Request body: plain JSON (no wrapper)
- Header: `Content-Type: application/json`
- Response: `{ "success": true }` or error JSON
